name: AMB-FUBINACA
summary: 1278 nM at CB2, and has been sold online as a designer drug. It was originally developed by Pfizer which described the compound in a patent in 2009, but was later abandoned and never tested on humans. AMB-FUBINACA was the most common synthetic cannabinoid identified in drug seizures by the Drug Enforcement Administration in 2017 and the first half of 2018.

pharmacology.text: AMB-FUBINACA (systematically named MMB-FUBINACA) is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is a potent agonist for the cannabinoid receptors, with Ki values of 10.04 nM at CB1 and 0.786 nM at CB2 and EC50 values of 0.5433 nM at CB1 and 0.1278 nM at CB2, and has been sold online as a designer drug.

uses.text: AMB-FUBINACA (systematically named MMB-FUBINACA) is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is a potent agonist for the cannabinoid receptors, with Ki values of 10.04 nM at CB1 and 0.786 nM at CB2 and EC50 values of 0.5433 nM at CB1 and 0.1278 nM at CB2, and has been sold online as a designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include a blank, groaning, zombie-like state with slow movement, along with a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, seizures and loss of consciousness. It is extremely potent and has been linked to deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 回報的反應包括目光空洞、呻吟、行動緩慢的「僵屍」狀態，並伴隨心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、癲癇發作與意識喪失。它極為強效，並曾與死亡案例有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 回报的反应包括目光空洞、呻吟、行动缓慢的「僵尸」状态，并伴随心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、癫痫发作与意识丧失。它极为强效，并曾与死亡案例有关。

fact.en: It was first described in a Pfizer patent in 2009 and then abandoned, never tested in people. It later appeared in street products, including a batch linked to a widely reported mass poisoning in New York in 2016.
fact.zh: 它最早出現在輝瑞 2009 年的一項專利中，隨後被放棄，從未在人體測試。後來它出現在街頭產品中，其中一批與 2016 年紐約一起廣受報導的集體中毒事件有關。
fact.zhHans: 它最早出现在辉瑞 2009 年的一项专利中，随后被放弃，从未在人体测试。后来它出现在街头产品中，其中一批与 2016 年纽约一起广受报导的集体中毒事件有关。
